newsitem.title: USA: Kaman hires Norden Systems president.
newsitem.headline: Kaman hires Norden Systems president.

text.p: Technology company Kaman Corp said on Tuesday that it had hired Kent Hutchinson, former president of the Norden Systems subsidiary of Northrop Grumman Corp, as the senior vice president of its Kaman Aerospace Corp and Kaman Aerospace International Corp units.
Hutchinson, 56, joined Norden Systems, then a subsidiary of United Technologies Corp, in 1991, to take charge of the IAF Multi Mode Radar System, Kaman said in a statement.
Prior to Norden, Hutchinson spent nearly 25 years in various positions with Northrop and other companies, in the defense industry, Kaman said.
